## Problem or workflow

Who encounters the problem, and what are they trying to accomplish? Use a fictional example without employee data.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the desired outcome and how someone would know it works.

## Alternatives considered

Describe existing workarounds or alternatives.

## Evidence and governance needs

What data would this require? What uncertainty, privacy limits or human review should the user see?

## Scope and environment

Relevant page/API, source commit/version and installation type, if applicable.
